name: music-200
notes: MiniMax Music Generation shape (platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/music-generation): POST /v1/music_generation returns data.audio (hex-encoded audio) + status, extra_info and base_resp; failures arrive inside a 200 envelope with base_resp.status_code != 0. The fixture's audio value is a truncated placeholder, not real audio. ACCESS RESTRICTION (same docs page): since 2026-08-20 the paid music APIs are closed to NEW users — existing paying users only; the free model IDs are discontinued. The gateway routes an entitled key; it cannot conjure access.
recorded_from: mock-upstream: canned MiniMax-shaped Music Generation response replayed by the test's mock engine, 2026-11-19. Recorded mock data, NOT a live provider call.
